title: Declared event RateUpdated is never emitted
description: The event RateUpdated(uint256 newRate, uint256 newBalance) is declared at line 106 but never emitted anywhere in the contract. Off-chain indexers register the event from the ABI and silently miss every rate transition.
impact: No fund risk. Dead event declaration; off-chain observability gap. Rate transitions occur in _updatePool (line 416), collectReward (line 283), and setDepletionDuration (line 188) without an explicit RateUpdated emit.
attackPath: Indexers register the RateUpdated event from the ABI.
No emit; rate transitions are invisible on-chain through this event.
recommendation: Either remove the declaration or emit RateUpdated(rewardPerSecond, rewardBalance) inside _updatePool after the recompute, and inside setDepletionDuration / collectReward after rewardPerSecond is reset. Emitting is the preferred fix because the observability is genuinely useful.
